name: Cairo I-57 Bridge
facts: The Cairo I-57 Bridge, a steel through arch marvel, opened its lanes to traffic in 1978, instantly becoming a vital artery for the Upper Mississippi region.
Spanning the mighty Mississippi, the Cairo I-57 Bridge carries four bustling lanes of Interstate 57, linking the southern tip of Illinois with the broader national highway network.
Designed as a steel through arch, the Cairo I-57 Bridge showcases engineering elegance, allowing unobstructed river traffic beneath while supporting heavy interstate loads across its 4-lane deck.
